info.title: card-sharing API
info.description: Errors use RFC 9457 application/problem+json (schema: ProblemDetails). Every operation carries `x-policy` (auth kind, role, attestation) from its deny-by-default route policy.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up. Never depends on downstream services.
Readiness: the instance can serve traffic (config loaded; DB/Redis checks join here later).

200.description: Ready to serve traffic. Auth: public.

post.summary:
Register this install's App Attest key. Auth: onb/ses. In log-only mode a failed attestation
still answers 204 (the key is not stored and the failure is recorded).

204.description: Processed (stored when the attestation is valid).

post.summary: Issue an attestation challenge. Auth: onb/ses.

Sign in with Apple. Auth: none (the ID token is the credential). Creates the account on first
sign-in (status `pending_age`, onboarding session); never links accounts by email (AC-1.3).

200.description: Signed in: an onboarding session for a new or unfinished account, a full session otherwise. Call GET /v1/me for the onboarding step.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: invalid, expired, forged or misaddressed ID token, nonce mismatch, or a replayed nonce.

403.description: ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: the account may not sign in (suspended, banned or deletion pending).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: provider not configured or unreachable, or a fail-closed store is down.

post.summary:
Request an email magic link. Auth: none. Always 202 for a well-formed request, whether or not
the email has an account (no enumeration, AC-1.2); the email is sent asynchronously. The link
works once, for 15 minutes, and only together with this device's PKCE verifier.

202.description: If the address can receive email, a sign-in link is on its way.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED (malformed email or challenge, unknown fields).

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: more than 5 requests in 15 minutes from this IP or for this email (same body either way).

post.summary:
Sign in with Google. Auth: none (the ID token is the credential). Creates the account on first
sign-in (status `pending_age`, onboarding session); never links accounts by email (AC-1.3), so
the same email as an Apple account is a separate account.

200.description: Signed in: an onboarding session for a new or unfinished account, a full session otherwise. Call GET /v1/me for the onboarding step.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: invalid, expired, forged or misaddressed ID token (including a token for another client id), nonce mismatch, or a replayed nonce.

403.description: ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: the account may not sign in (suspended, banned or deletion pending).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: provider not configured or unreachable, or a fail-closed store is down.

post.summary: Rotate a refresh token. Auth: none (the refresh token in the body is the credential).

200.description: New token pair; the presented refresh token is now used up.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED (unknown token) or SESSION_REVOKED (reused, revoked or ended session: sign in again).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (rate-limit store down; auth fails closed).

post.description:
Ends the friendship, drops their pending requests to me, cancels mine to them, and silently
refuses future requests both ways (they get the usual answer; nothing is delivered). The
account must be related to me (friend or a friend request either way), otherwise 404.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no related account with this id.

delete.summary: Unblock someone. Auth: ses. The friendship is not restored.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the caller has not blocked this id.

get.summary: Limits, feature flags, registry kill switches and the text filter's client hints. Auth: none.
get.description:
Cacheable: `Cache-Control: public, max-age=…` plus a strong `ETag`; a matching
`If-None-Match` answers 304 with no body.

200.description: Public client configuration (cacheable, no user data).

304.description: The `If-None-Match` tag is current; no body.

get.summary: My pending friend requests. Auth: ses.
get.description:
`incoming`: requests addressed to me that I have not answered; for a minor, a request from an
adult with no mutual friends carries `hint: "adult_no_mutual_friends"`. `outgoing`: requests I
sent that are still open; they all show as pending (declines are silent).

post.summary:
Send a friend request to the owner of an invite or to a handle-search result. Auth: ses + att;
`Idempotency-Key` required.
post.description:
The inviter must accept before a friendship exists. A request between accounts with a block
(either way) gets the same 201 and is never delivered. Repeating a request returns the open
one.

201.description: Sent (or already open). Identical for silently dropped requests.

404.description: NOT_FOUND (unknown invite; foreign, forged or expired search ref) or INVITE_EXPIRED.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED (also: 20 open requests or 30 sent in 24 hours; Retry-After).

delete.summary: Cancel a friend request I sent. Auth: ses.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Request id from the outgoing list.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no open request from the caller with this id.

post.summary: Accept a friend request addressed to me. Auth: ses + att.
post.description:
The 20-friend cap is re-checked for both sides at accept time; when either is full the request
stays pending.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Request id from the incoming list.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no pending request to the caller with this id.

post.summary: Decline a friend request addressed to me. Auth: ses. Silent: the sender is not told.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Request id from the incoming list.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no pending request to the caller with this id.

delete.summary: Remove a friend. Auth: ses. Silent: the other person gets no notification (AC-6.2).

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the caller has no friend with this id.

get.summary: Preview an invite before adding the inviter. Auth: ses; rate-limited per client IP.
get.description:
Unknown tokens, suspended inviters and blocks (either way) all answer the same 404
`NOT_FOUND`; a reset, expired or used-up invite answers 404 `INVITE_EXPIRED`.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token part of an invite link (22 characters).

200.description: The inviter's display name (no avatar for a minor's invite).

404.description: NOT_FOUND (unknown) or INVITE_EXPIRED (reset, expired or used up).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (rate limit store down; fails closed).

post.summary: Submit the date of birth once. Auth: onb (account in `pending_age` only).
post.description:
Refusal is neutral: 403 `AGE_GATE_REFUSED` with no threshold or region in the body; the
pending account is deleted and the same device / sign-in identity is refused for 24 h.

200.description: Admitted; continue with the profile step.

403.description: AGE_GATE_REFUSED (neutral; account removed), AGE_ALREADY_SUBMITTED (DOB is locked) or FORBIDDEN (not an onboarding session).

post.summary: Record the OS age signal for the caller's account. Auth: onb/ses.

204.description: Stored; a minor signal applies from the next request.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: OS age-signal ingestion is disabled.

put.summary: Claim or change my handle. Auth: onb/ses (after the age gate).
put.description:
Free to change for 24 h after the first claim; afterwards once per 30 days (both config). A
handle released after the grace window stays reserved for 30 days. Finishing the profile
(display name and handle set) makes the account `active` and the current session a full one.

403.description: ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE (age gate not passed) or ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED.

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (rate limit store down; fails closed).

post.summary: Is this handle available to me? Auth: onb/ses (after the age gate).
post.description:
Rate-limited (20/min and 100/day per user, fails closed): it necessarily reveals whether a
handle is taken, and nothing else.

403.description: ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE (age gate not passed) or ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED.

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (rate limit store down; fails closed).

get.summary: Get (or create) my invite link. Auth: ses.

200.description: The caller's live invite link (the same until reset; a minor's used-up or expired link is replaced).

post.summary: Reset my invite link: the old link answers "invite expired" from now on. Auth: ses.

put.summary: Set my display name. Auth: onb/ses (after the age gate).
put.description:
The name is sanitized (NFC, invisible and bidi characters removed, whitespace collapsed,
combining marks capped) and checked against the term lists; the stored form is returned.

200.description: Saved; the response carries the stored (sanitized) name.

403.description: ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE (age gate not passed) or ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED.

patch.summary: Change my privacy settings. Auth: ses.
patch.description:
Turning "Findable by handle" on needs the region's discovery age (`discovery.min_age`): below
it the answer is 403 `POLICY_DISALLOWED`. Turning it off is always allowed and takes effect on
the next search (the standard "no one found").

403.description: POLICY_DISALLOWED (under the discovery age), ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE or ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED.

post.summary: Upload an image into quarantine. Auth: onb/ses.
post.description:
The body is the raw image (`Content-Type: image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `image/webp` or
`application/octet-stream`), at most 10 MiB, at most 4096 px per side. The format comes from
the magic bytes; a declared image type that disagrees with them is refused. The same bytes of
the same kind return the existing upload (200) instead of a new one (201). The image is
re-encoded and scanned before anyone can see it; this endpoint never returns a URL.

200.description: The same image of this kind was uploaded before.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: bad kind, malformed header or dimensions out of range.

415.description: MEDIA_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: not PNG, JPEG or WebP.

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: object storage is down or not configured.

get.summary: Fetch a signed media object. Auth: none (the signature is the capability).
get.description:
Returns the image bytes (`image/webp`) when the signature over the exact key, expiry and viewer
is valid and unexpired; otherwise 403. Clients never build these URLs: they come inside DTOs
(with `expires_at`) and are refetched through the DTO after expiry.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: Viewer id the URL was issued to (audit).

403.description: FORBIDDEN: missing, malformed, tampered or expired signature.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the object no longer exists (deleted card).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: signing or storage not configured.

get.summary: State of one of my uploads. Auth: onb/ses. Owner only; never returns a URL.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no upload of mine with this id.

get.summary: Invite landing data for `/i/<token>`. Auth: svc (web server only).
get.description:
Unknown, malformed, reset, expired and used-up tokens, and invites whose inviter is suspended,
banned or deleted, all answer the identical 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token part of an invite link (22 characters).

parameters.name: X-Client-IP
parameters.description: The visitor's IP address as the web server saw it (keys the per-IP limit).

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED (X-Client-IP missing or not an IP address).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (rate limit store down; fails closed).

get.summary: My active device sessions, most recently used first. Auth: ses.

delete.summary: Log out this device: revokes the current session (and its widget token). Auth: onb/ses.

204.description: Session revoked; its tokens stop working immediately.

post.summary:
Log out everywhere: revokes every session of the account, including this one and all widget
tokens. Auth: ses.

204.description: Every access and refresh token of the account stopped working.

delete.summary:
Revoke one of my device sessions (and its widget token). Auth: ses; the session must be the
caller's own (anything else is 404).

204.description: Revoked; its tokens stop working immediately.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no live session of the caller with this id.

post.summary: Find a friend by exact handle. Auth: ses + att.
post.description:
At most one result, only on an exact case-insensitive match. Accounts under the region's
discovery age, accounts that turned "Findable by handle" off, blocks either way and your own
handle all answer exactly like a handle nobody has (same body, same latency class). Limited
per account (10/min, 30/day), per device and per IP; over a limit the answer is a generic
"try later" (429).

200.description: `{result: null}` or the one account found.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED (body shape only; any string is searched).

503.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE (rate limit store down; fails closed).

AgeRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/me/age`. Country hints can only make the policy stricter.

declared_country.description: Country the user says they live in (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), if asked.

store_country.description: App store storefront country reported by the OS (a hint, never trusted to loosen rules).

signal.description: `minor` when the OS says the user is under 18, `adult` otherwise.

min_app_version.description: Clients below this version must update (requests get 426 `UPGRADE_REQUIRED`).

text_filter.description:
Sanitizer caps and term lists of the shared text filter, for instant hints while typing
(captions, names). The server checks again on submit and its answer is final.

attestation.description:
The `attestKey` object, standard base64 (made with `clientDataHash = SHA-256(challenge
bytes)`).

AppleSignInRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/auth/apple`. The account is derived from the verified token only.

authorization_code.description:
One-time authorization code from the same sheet. The server exchanges it for an Apple
refresh token (kept encrypted, revoked on account deletion). Optional.

oneOf.description: The signing-in device. Recommended: device-scoped limits and cooldowns use it.

id_token.description: Apple identity token (JWS) from the native Sign in with Apple sheet.

nonce.description:
The raw nonce the app generated for this sign-in (16 to 256 visible ASCII characters,
single use). The app passes `lowercase hex SHA-256(nonce)` to Apple; the token's `nonce`
claim must match.

ChallengeResponse.description:
A single-use challenge, valid 5 minutes, for one key attestation or one `X-Attestation`
proof (`clientDataHash = SHA-256(challenge bytes || request hash)`).

ClientLimits.description: Product limits shown by the app. The server enforces its own copies.

CreateFriendRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/friend-requests`: exactly one of `invite_token` and `search_ref`.

invite_token.description: Token of the invite the caller opened.

search_ref.description: `ref` of a handle-search result the caller got (10 minutes, caller only).

DeviceRequest.description: The device a session is issued to. `id` is a UUID the app generates once per install.

code_challenge.description:
PKCE S256 challenge: base64url (no padding) of SHA-256 of a random verifier the app keeps
on this device (43 characters). Verifying the link (T-23) needs that verifier.

items.description: Most recent friendship first (at most the friend cap, 20).

GoogleSignInRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/auth/google`. The account is derived from the verified token only.

oneOf.description: The signing-in device. Recommended: device-scoped limits and cooldowns use it.

id_token.description: Google ID token (JWS) from the native Google sign-in.

HandleCheckResponse.description: Availability of a handle for the caller. Nothing about any other account is returned.

available.description: `false` when taken, reserved or otherwise not claimable; `true` for the caller's own.

handle.description: `^[a-z0-9._]{3,20}$` after lowercasing (uppercase input is accepted and lowercased).

contains.description:
Blocked when the term appears anywhere inside a folded word (or a spelled-out run of
single letters such as `f.u.c.k`). Use for terms that rarely occur inside innocent words.

words.description: Blocked when the folded text has a whole word equal to the term.

ImageBytes.description: Raw image bytes (request body of the upload).

is_self.description: The caller opened their own invite ("That's you!"); sending a request is refused.

InviteResponse.description: My personal invite link. Share it as a link or QR code.

expires_at.description:
When the link stops working on its own: set only for minors' invites (AC-4.4, region
policy; they also stop after a few uses). `null` = valid until reset.

url.description: `<share host>/i/<token>`; the token is 128 random bits (22 base64url characters).

InviterView.description: The inviter as shown before sending a request.

KillSwitches.description: Registry ids switched off remotely; the app hides them and the server rejects them.

policy.description:
Region rules that apply to this account (strictest of the signals stored at sign-up and
the current request). The app renders only what these allow.

profile.description: What the caller has set so far (empty fields before the profile step).

MediaView.description: An upload as its owner sees it. Never carries a URL or a storage key.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details with two extension members: `code` and `requestId`.

code.description: Stable error code clients can switch on.

detail.description: Safe, human-readable explanation. Never contains internal details.

requestId.description: Id of the failing request (same value as the `X-Request-Id` response header).

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type (`about:blank` = see `status` and `code`).

ProfileRequest.description: Body of `PUT /v1/me/profile`. The account is always the caller's; no id is accepted.

display_name.description: 2-30 characters (grapheme clusters) after sanitizing; not unique, never searchable.

ProfileResponse.description: Result of a profile write: the account status and onboarding step after it, and the profile.

ProfileView.description:
The caller's own profile. Display names are stored sanitized (what is returned is what
others will see).

PublicInviteResponse.description: What the invite landing page shows.

policy_config_version.description: Version of the loaded region policy config.

RefreshRequest.description:
Body of `POST /v1/auth/refresh`. Only the refresh token: the session (and therefore the
account) is derived from it, never from a client-supplied id.

hint.description:
Present only on incoming requests to a minor whose sender is an adult with no mutual
friends (AC-5.5). Never present for adult recipients.

handle.description:
The exact handle, case-insensitive, with or without a leading `@`. Partial input never
matches anything.

oneOf.description: `null` = "No one found": the same for a missing handle and for any hidden account.

ref.description:
Pass as `search_ref` to `POST /v1/friend-requests` within 10 minutes. Opaque, and only valid
for the account that searched.

SentRequestView.description: A request as its sender sees it: pending until accepted or expired.

status.description: Always `pending` for the sender (declines and blocks are silent).

SessionView.description: One signed-in device. No token material.

client_label.description: Platform and app version, e.g. `ios 1.2.0` (null when the device sent none).

ip_country.description: ISO country seen at sign-in, when known.

findable_by_handle.description: Let others find me by exact handle (adults only).

SettingsView.description: The caller's privacy settings, as they apply right now.

can_be_findable.description: Whether this account may turn `findable_by_handle` on (false under the discovery age).

findable_by_handle.description:
Whether others can find me by exact handle. Always `false` under the region's discovery
age (the toggle cannot be turned on then).

TextFilterHints.description:
The filter's settings as served to clients in `GET /v1/config` (#213): the sanitizer caps and
the term lists exactly as written in `config/text_filter.yaml`. For instant hints in the app
only; the server's own check stays authoritative. Public by design (EM decision 2026-11-05).

max_chars_per_grapheme.description: Grapheme clusters with more code points than this are dropped.

max_marks_per_grapheme.description: Combining marks kept per grapheme cluster (viramas exempt).

TokenPair.description: A new access + refresh token pair. Store both in the device's secure storage only.

refresh_token.description: Opaque, single use. Replaying a used one signs out the whole session.

UserSummaryView.description: Another account as shown in request and friend lists.

tags.name: me
tags.description: The caller's own account and onboarding

tags.name: social
tags.description: Invites, friend requests, friends, blocks and handle search (US-4, US-5, US-5a, US-6, US-26)

tags.name: media
tags.description: Image uploads into quarantine and their state (ADR-0005)
